svg.title: Ethan Soh
svg.desc: Ethan's TV home screen as a banner: 23 oil paintings he approved for his TV rotate every 6 seconds, his name ETHAN SOH standing where the TV draws its clock, behind each painting's subject. Widget cards on both sides: GitHub contributions this month, his next step (a 44-week internship from April 2027), credentials (Claude Certified Architect, ISC2 CC, Anthropic Academy, BB Senior Cadet Lieutenant, Founder's Award, cGPA 3.77), his live Claude plan usage, his Claude Code activity heatmap and tokens, GitHub, and competitions (Hack The Box 30th of 6,744, Cyber Conquest finalist, BrainHack CDDC finalist, PolyFinTech100 quarterfinal).
